title: Web Crawler Restrictions, AI Training Datasets & Political Biases

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the differential rates of AI web crawler restrictions (robots.txt) across websites based on their political leaning and factual reporting scores, and evaluating the shifting representation of hyperpartisan content in training datasets.

Applying chi-square statistics to identify word co-occurrence patterns alongside terms referring to age (e.g., 'Young', 'Old') in hyperpartisan left and right-leaning text corpora compared to balanced text.
Applying chi-square statistics to identify word co-occurrence patterns alongside gender terms (e.g., 'Woman', 'Man') in hyperpartisan left and right-leaning text corpora compared to balanced text.
Applying chi-square statistics to identify word co-occurrence patterns alongside the term 'Transgender' in hyperpartisan left and right-leaning text corpora compared to balanced text.
Applying chi-square statistics to identify word co-occurrence patterns alongside the term 'LGBTQ' in hyperpartisan left and right-leaning text corpora compared to balanced text.
Applying chi-square statistics to identify word co-occurrence patterns alongside the term 'Immigrant' in hyperpartisan left and right-leaning text corpora compared to balanced text.
Applying chi-square statistics to identify word co-occurrence patterns alongside the term 'Muslim' in hyperpartisan left and right-leaning text corpora compared to balanced text.
